messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: installing ggplot2
parts:
Your version of R is too old; the current version of plyr (1.8.1) does
not explicitly require a more recent version, but it depends on Rcpp >=
0.11.0, which requires R >= 3.0.0. It is *in principle* possible to
cobble together older versions of the packages by using the archives,
but it's a big pain -- if there is any way at all that you can update to
the latest version of R everything will just work.
